issue.title: test_app_import_budget: TUI app import loads 3292 modules against a 3290 budget (deterministic, unattributed)
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py::test_tui_app_import_stays_under_startup_budget
fails deterministically with `assert 3292 < 3290` (_MAX_MODULE_COUNT = 3290, line 13):
importing sase.ace.tui.app loads 3292 modules in a fresh interpreter, two over budget.

This is the module-count assertion, not the wall-clock flake tracked and closed as
sase-136 (which switched the elapsed check to process CPU time).

Found 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_31 while verifying an unrelated change. The count is
exactly 3292 in every run and at each of the five most recent commits (244442ee8,
9cfb06a54, 9231c9352, 65c8169f9, e65cc22ee, each run in a detached worktree), so no recent
commit moved it. A constant, environment-shaped number suggests the total depends on the
interpreter (this venv is Python 3.14) and the installed plugin set (sase-github and
sase-research-artifacts are installed by `just install`) rather than on master. Unverified
whether CI or other workspaces see the same count; confirm that first, then either raise
the budget with a recorded reason or cut two module imports from the TUI startup path.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The module count is exactly 3292 on every run and at all five most recent commits checked in detached worktrees; it is a counted integer, not a wall-clock measurement, so it cannot vary with load. A rerun on the same tree never passed.
